cards.name: Fireball
cards.text: Kezzar's classic. A quick blast for 5 damage. Just watch the texture seams.

cards.name: Ember Sprite
cards.text: A giggling cinder. Every hit adds a burn stack (up to 3); burning deals 1 damage per second per stack.

cards.name: Pyroclasm
cards.text: A wide blast for 11 damage that sets the enemy burning: 2 damage per second for 6 seconds.

cards.name: Inferno Golem
cards.text: Assembled from furnace slag and spite. It does not negotiate.

cards.name: Meteor Cascade
cards.text: A lobbed rock for 22 damage in a huge blast. Destroys every enemy summon it lands near. Lead your target.

cards.name: Frost Shard
cards.text: Deals 4 damage and slows the enemy for 3 seconds.

cards.name: Ice Ward
cards.text: Grants 8 shield. Shield absorbs damage before health.

cards.name: Glacier Wall
cards.text: Grants 16 shield. Slightly too big for the doorway.

cards.name: Frostbound Sentinel
cards.text: Slow, patient and very hard to melt. Its strikes slow the enemy for 2 seconds.

cards.name: Absolute Zero
cards.text: A freezing blast for 14 damage. Slows the enemy for 4 seconds and freezes their summons solid for 4 seconds.

cards.name: Static Spark
cards.text: Instant lightning for 3 damage. Refunds 1 mana if it connects.

cards.name: Chain Lightning
cards.text: Instant lightning for 5 damage that arcs on to every nearby enemy summon for 3.

cards.name: Thunder Roc
cards.text: Glass cannon with feathers. Its dives crackle with lightning.

cards.name: Tempest
cards.text: A lightning strike for 10 damage that blasts everything around the impact and steals 2 mana.

cards.name: Shadow Bolt
cards.text: Deals 5 damage and heals you for 2. The bolt is mostly regret.

cards.name: Bone Knight
cards.text: Formerly a paladin. Currently a lot lighter.

cards.name: Soul Drain
cards.text: Deals 8 damage and heals you for 8.

cards.name: Curse of Rot
cards.text: Poisons the enemy: 3 damage per second for 4 seconds.

cards.name: Arcane Missiles
cards.text: Fires three violet darts for 2 damage each. Spread them across a dodging target.

cards.name: Mana Font
cards.text: Your mana regenerates twice as fast for 5 seconds.

cards.name: Mirror Image
cards.text: Look at an enemy summon or placed object and copy it: a holofoil mirror image with its strength and health appears on your side. With nothing of the enemy's in view the card cannot be cast.

cards.name: Time Warp
cards.text: Stops time for 2 seconds for everyone but you: the enemy wizard, their summons and their spells stand still.

cards.name: Holy Light
cards.text: Heal 7 health. Brought to you by a very smug cleric.

cards.name: Paladin's Oath
cards.text: Grants 12 shield and heals 4.

cards.name: Seraph
cards.text: Lifesteal: whenever it strikes, you heal for the damage dealt.

cards.name: Divine Verdict
cards.text: A holy blast for 20 damage that heals you for 10. Case closed.

cards.name: Fire Totem
cards.text: Plants a carved totem where the card lands. For 8 seconds it spits fireballs at the enemy wizard for 3 damage each. 8 health.

cards.name: Phoenix
cards.text: A blazing bird. When it dies it leaves an egg; if the egg survives 3 seconds, the Phoenix is reborn.

cards.name: Rune Trap
cards.text: Lays a rune where the card lands. The first enemy wizard or summon to step on it takes 10 damage and is poisoned: 2 per second for 4 seconds.

cards.name: Blood Pact
cards.text: Pay 12 health to gain 4 mana on the spot. Cannot kill you.

cards.name: Gravity Well
cards.text: Throws a singularity. Where it lands, a well opens for 4 seconds that drags the enemy and their summons toward it, dealing 2 damage per second inside.

cards.name: Rune Bulwark
cards.text: Raises a stone wall where the card lands, facing you. Blocks spells and movement for 8 seconds or until its 14 health is gone.

cards.name: Mirror Wand
cards.text: Copies the last card you cast, for 1 more mana than it cost. Before you have cast anything it is a plain mirror: for 6 seconds the next enemy spell that hits you is flung back at its caster.

cards.name: Blink
cards.text: Teleport 7 metres in the direction you are aiming. Dodge, close in, or vanish behind a wall.

cards.name: Cyclone
cards.text: Releases a tornado that travels where you aim for 5 seconds, hurling back the enemy and their summons and dealing 2 damage per hit.

cards.name: Magic Injection
cards.text: Look at one of your summons or totems and inject it: +3 damage on every attack it makes. With nothing of yours in view the card cannot be cast.

cards.name: Vital Tincture
cards.text: Gives 4 health to the summon or placed object of yours you are looking at. With none in sight, it heals you for 4 instead.

cards.name: Barrel
cards.text: Rolls a powder keg along the floor ahead of you. It deals 4 damage to every enemy and summon it rolls through, and bursts on walls and bulwarks.

cards.name: Cursed Blast
cards.text: A purple blast for 2 damage that curses the enemy and every summon around the impact for 8 seconds. A cursed summon that dies rises again as your Ember Sprite.

cards.name: Mana Pump
cards.text: Places a pump with 1 health that runs for 12 seconds and gives you 1 mana every 3 seconds. When it breaks or runs out you get 1 more mana.

cards.name: Cinder Trail
cards.text: For 6 seconds your footsteps leave burning ground. Enemies that cross it burn for 2 damage per second for 3 seconds.

cards.name: Wildfire
cards.text: A fireball for 7 damage. Each time it kills a summon it leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 metres, up to 4 times.

cards.name: Phoenix Feather
cards.text: Tuck a feather into the summon of yours you are looking at: the first time it dies it rises again with half its health.

cards.name: Candlewick
cards.text: Set down a candle that burns for 20 seconds. While it is lit your fire cards cost 1 less. One hit snuffs it out.

cards.name: Icicle Volley
cards.text: Five shards of ice in a fan, 3 damage each. Up close they all land.

cards.name: Snowblind
cards.text: A blizzard clings to the enemy for 5 seconds: they cannot see further than 6 metres.

cards.name: Snowman Decoy
cards.text: A snowman in your hat, 10 health. Enemy summons and totems attack it before anything else.

cards.name: Lightning Rod
cards.text: A 12-health rod. Every enemy bolt aimed within 6 metres of it, and the final storm's lightning, strikes the rod instead.

cards.name: Tailwind
cards.text: Move 40% faster for 5 seconds.

cards.name: Skybreaker
cards.text: Mark the spot you aim at. After 1.5 seconds a colossal bolt lands there: 22 damage to every enemy within 2.5 metres.

cards.name: Grave Hand
cards.text: A skeletal hand waits under the floor. It grabs the first enemy to pass and roots them for 2 seconds. They can still cast.

cards.name: Soul Jar
cards.text: The jar keeps a quarter of all damage you deal. Break it yourself, or wait 15 seconds, and it heals you for what it holds.

cards.name: Nightmare
cards.text: The enemy's hand turns face down for 6 seconds. They throw blind.

cards.name: Corpse Explosion
cards.text: Sacrifice one of your summons. It bursts for twice its remaining health, up to 16 damage, within 3 metres.

cards.name: Dread Lantern
cards.text: A 10-health lantern. Enemies within 5 metres of its light deal 25% less damage.

cards.name: Spell Steal
cards.text: A bolt for 2 damage. If it hits, a copy of the next card in the enemy's deck drops into your hand.

cards.name: Card Trick
cards.text: Throw away your hand and draw 4 fresh cards at once.

cards.name: Purify
cards.text: Wash off burn, poison, slow and curse. Gain 1 mana for each one removed.
